---
title: "Trap: a code block so wide it runs off the paper"
mdbrand: {brand: none, style: note}
---

Past the measure a code block only warns: it prints into the margin. This one
is wider than the margin as well, and the sheet cut it: the columns past the
edge are not in the PDF.

```
XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
```
